### 🧩 Summary

Briefly describe the issue being fixed.

### 💥 Root Cause

Explain what’s causing the problem (e.g., wrong condition, race condition, missing dependency).

### 🔧 Fix Plan

Describe how you plan to fix it — code area, approach, or key changes.

### 🧪 Verification Steps

How will you test the fix? Include manual steps or test cases.

### ✅ Checklist

- [ ] Bug reproduced
- [ ] Fix implemented
- [ ] Tests added/updated
- [ ] Verified in staging
